note: Richland County (SC) zoning districts are shown in the county's RCGeo viewer from a GeoServer layer rcgeo_zoning_wgs84 that is only served as WMS (WFS returns 'Service WFS is disabled'); no county-wide queryable zoning service found on richlandmaps.com, richlandcountysc.gov, or ArcGIS Online. The only queryable ArcGIS zoning layer is a 2024 Irmo-only layer (8,559 polygons, 39% zone fill, no districts at the county's interior point, so it fails validation). Columbia city zoning was not found as a queryable service either.
